source.publication: 2025 Oklahoma Resident Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions (Form 511 packet)
source.section: Form 511 lines 1-14 and 18 (PDF pages 42-43); select line instructions (PDF pages 9-10); standard deduction line 10 (PDF page 10); exemptions line 11 and the Regular exemption terms (PDF pages 8 and 10); Tax Table (PDF pages 27-38); tax computation worksheets for 100,000 or more (PDF page 38)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 214,700.00 = 214,700.00. Federal taxable income = 214,700.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 183,200.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Oklahoma starts from federal AGI). Form 511: line 1 federal AGI 214,700.00; line 2 subtractions 0.00; line 3 = 214,700.00 - 0.00 = 214,700.00; line 4 out-of-state income 0.00; line 5 214,700.00; line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 Oklahoma AGI 214,700.00; line 8 adjustments 0.00; line 9 214,700.00; line 10 standard deduction (married joint) 12,700.00; line 11 exemptions: 2 Regular + 0 Special = 2 x 1,000.00 = 2,000.00 (no one is 65 or older, 0 Special); line 12 = 12,700.00 + 2,000.00 = 14,700.00; line 13 taxable income = 214,700.00 - 14,700.00 = 200,000.00; line 14 tax (the projection's brackets as numbers; the booklet prints only a table and worksheets): 0.25% x 2,000.00 = 5.0000 + 0.75% x 3,000.00 = 22.5000 + 1.75% x 2,500.00 = 43.7500 + 2.75% x 2,300.00 = 63.2500 + 3.75% x 4,600.00 = 172.5000 + 4.75% x 185,600.00 = 8,816.0000; total 9,123.0000 = 9,123.00. Line 13 is 100,000 or more, so the form uses the worksheet on PDF page 38 (joint, head of household or qualified widow(er)): 4,373 + 0.0475 x 100,000.00 = 9,123.00; expected keeps the schedule figure. Lines 15-17 credits 0.00; line 18 income tax 9,123.00. For the second column the worksheet and the schedule agree: 4,373.00 at 100,000.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are derived from the printed tax table and the 100,000-and-over worksheets; the booklet prints no schedule. Below 100,000 tax is figured on the exact income, where the booklet taxes each 50-dollar row at its midpoint and rounds. At 100,000 and over the single and separate worksheet starts from 4,562 where the schedule gives 4,561.50.
